item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to admit an exhausted name whose source edge was removed by the recycling pass into the signed retirement path, retire the 13 stranded names through it, and leave exactly the original ten sourceless; imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3251-3273 builds the former-source evidence, :3455-3456 unions it into the eligible ids, and live_apply.json records 13 applied with a ten-name readback in live_readback.json.

justifications.evidence: baseline_suite_isolated.log and after_suite_isolated.log each end in EXIT=0 with 8789 passed, 12 skipped at d12142b47 and at 4345f5193, so the recorded added_failure_count 0 is read from the gate logs, though both arms deselect the 22 new graph cases that reproduction.log and focused_head.log carry instead.
justifications.fit: the addition keeps the file's foundation-runtime indirection and row-dict idiom at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3174-3205, and imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:1929-1939 extends the neighbouring multi-count log call without a plan-derived name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3251-3273 admits only an exhausted, non-derived identity carrying its own released-source or migration-receipt evidence, :3455-3456 unions those ids into the eligible set, and live_apply.json records changed 13 while live_readback.json enumerates exactly the original ten.
justifications.reuse: the admission extends the classifier that already owns the population at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_supersession.py:3245-3303 and the readback reuses find_sourceless_live_name_rows at imas_codex/standard_names/source_invariant.py:204 with no exemption added; a search for an owner of a released or claimable source predicate found only source_claim_predicate at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_foundation.py:201, whose frozen-stage binding test is strictly weaker than the zero-producer, zero-attempt condition added here.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d12142b47..a449ce31e lists graph_supersession.py, loop.py, the two test files and the two evidence files, all six inside the declared orientation_write_paths and nothing else.
